items.label: la poitrine
items.scene: PA's toy TRAIN ("pwah-TREEN") chugs right across a dad's broad CHEST as he floats on his back, puffing it out proudly.

items.label: la gorge
items.scene: A GORGEOUS ("GORZH") pelican with a flower behind its ear puffs out the big pouch under its THROAT.

items.label: le cœur
items.scene: A scruffy little CUR ("KUHR") dog floats on a big red HEART-shaped pool ring, hugging it tight.

items.label: le ventre
items.scene: A walrus floats on its back, its round BELLY warmed by the bubbling VENT ("VAHNTR") of the pool jet.

items.label: le souffle
items.scene: A swimmer takes a deep BREATH ("SOOFL") and puffs out her cheeks as round as the SOUFFLÉ on the poolside table.

items.label: le poing
items.scene: A giant wooden chess PAWN ("PWAN") in swimming goggles raises a tiny FIST in victory at the pool's edge.

items.label: le doigt
items.scene: A garden-gnome DWARF ("DWAH") lifeguard on a tall chair wags one FINGER: no running by the pool!

items.label: le fond
items.scene: A glowing PHONE ("FOHN") slips into the pool and sinks to the BOTTOM, and a duckling peers down at it through the clear water.
